_about: House Face chore law (Dan, locked Thu Oct 1 2026 8:01 PM CT; plates/2026-10-01/redesign/CHORE-LAW-2026-10-01.md). The only copy of the chore rules in Atlas's lane: it replaces kid layer v3 (one Harris mission by weekday, the seven-day gate on kids-week quests, per-kid week-closed unlocks, Us together = all three weeks). Read by scripts/kid-layer.mjs. Branch wall-redesign-atlas, not wired. Copy is wall text: short, operational, sentence case.

week._about: Law week = Sunday 12:00 AM to the next Sunday (Week win is the Sunday tile; repair runs until Saturday fun).

musts._about: Four per kid, binary, no partial credit. Tap ids live in the existing hub keys house-checkoffs:<kid>:<YYYY-MM-DD>.

items.did: took the dish to the sink

dragon._about: On Hayes, Dragon fed replaces the fourth MUST only while the dragon is in the house. Not in the house now (Oct 1 2026).

choice._about: One shared job per day, rotating through the four. First claim tap owns it and locks it to that kid; claims close at lockAt; unclaimed at lockAt = a Dad Seat exception.

jobs.did: took the trash to the can

close._about: Bedtime window at the wall; each kid closes their own tile. Overnight (after closesAt, before morningAt) the Dad Seat shows open loops only. Dan can move the times.

captain._about: Hayes's reward includes captain of the night. The seat rotates nightly through the kids home that night, in this order.

ainsley._about: No stars, no counts. Trusted-with only. A job she has closed five home days running gets no check. Her public line is specific and rare, never generic praise.

weekWin._about: Sunday tile for the week just ended: one name and one reason, rotating by week; otherwise house held.

usTogether._about: 12 closes available (three kids, Mon to Thu bedtime CLOSE, each with that day's MUSTS closed); 10 or more lights Weekend fun.

repair._about: A missed MUST can be closed until Saturday fun (Saturday 12:00 AM CT, the safe edge until Dan sets a time). It never carries into next week.

pack._about: Travel week = an all-day trip with the kids on the calendar (tripPattern, e.g. Dan + Kids Nashville) overlaps this law week, or Dan lists the week id in travelWeeks. A plain handoff Friday is not travel. Three items only; dark once the bag is at the door.

mystery._about: Once a week, on one Mon to Thu day by rotation; hidden on a kid's tile until that kid's MUSTS are closed that day. Time and picks only. Atlas draft list: Dan can replace it.
